branch_assignments.rationale: Open VLA and action-reasoning release with strong direct baseline value.
Physically grounded spatial reasoning benchmark with execution relevance.
World-simulator / world-action-model fit, but blocked pending visual review.
Embodied foundation model with downstream VLA fit, but blocked pending demo/release review.

paper.title: MolmoAct2
paper.data: Molmo 2-ER reasoning corpus, MolmoAct2-Bimanual YAM, filtered DROID Franka, SO100/101, Bridge, and Open X-Embodiment-derived robot data
paper.method: embodied-reasoning VLM with a KV-cache bridge to a flow-matching action expert plus adaptive-depth reasoning and an open action tokenizer
paper.task: open real-world robot manipulation with reasoning-heavy single-arm and bimanual control
paper.novelty: combines open embodied reasoning, open action tokenization, low-cost/bimanual data, and broad release artifacts into a deployment-oriented VLA stack
paper.project_relevance: Strong open baseline for reasoning-to-action transfer, bimanual manipulation, and low-cost embodiment deployment.

paper.title: WorldArena 2.0
paper.data: expanded embodied world-model benchmark with visuotactile, simulated, and real-world evaluation surfaces plus public leaderboard infrastructure
paper.method: benchmark extension that evaluates world models across modality, functionality, and platform with perceptual metrics and downstream embodied utility tests
paper.task: evaluate embodied world models as perceptual predictors, data engines, policy evaluators, action planners, and interactive RL environments
paper.novelty: extends WorldArena from vision-only simulator-centric evaluation toward visuotactile, policy-optimization, and cross-platform embodied testing
paper.project_relevance: Direct evaluation target for closed-loop embodied generation, world-action models, and simulator-backed policy learning.

paper.title: Embodied3DBench
paper.data: robot-centric embodied 3D benchmark with 6 task categories, 12 subcategories, 21k+ QA pairs, and a 1.3M-pair synthetic training set
paper.method: diagnostic benchmark plus synthetic QA training data for low-level embodied spatial intelligence
paper.task: benchmark low-level embodied spatial understanding and interaction-oriented perception for VLMs
paper.novelty: separates structural spatial understanding from interaction-oriented perception and pairs diagnosis with a large synthetic improvement set
paper.project_relevance: Useful low-level benchmark for grounding, affordance, grasp-point, and trajectory-perception checks in generated or reconstructed worlds.

paper.title: ESPIRE
paper.data: Isaac-Sim-based embodied spatial reasoning benchmark with 148 localization reasoning types and functional-program-generated scene-graph targets
paper.method: fully generative localization-plus-execution benchmark for embodied spatial reasoning in simulation
paper.task: diagnose action-oriented embodied spatial reasoning of VLMs under physically grounded execution settings
paper.novelty: turns spatial reasoning evaluation from static QA into a physically grounded generative localization and execution problem
paper.project_relevance: Strong validator template for reasoning-to-act spatial competence in interactive embodied generation systems.
